Henry knows exactly what he is being used for, because Kristine tells him outright. What neither of them arranges for is any of it turning real.

She lost her husband and her baby.
Vivienne has lost both her husband and her child, and what is left of her runs on revenge and very little else. Killing the woman she blames would be over far too quickly to satisfy anything. So she decides to take that woman's husband instead, and to make sure she is watching while it happens.

She runs from her own pack and finds him.
Katya has not come into her wolf yet, but she is a Luna healer, and the only one who can heal the girl who has spent years bullying her: her own Alpha's daughter. The title brings threats with it, so Katya runs for the Black Creek pack. There she meets Alpha Ezra, who turns out to be her fated wolf and the one man willing to stand in front of her.

He said he was waiting until marriage. Not with her, as it happens.
Serena finds her boyfriend Ken in bed with Carol, her half sister, after years of him telling her he was saving himself for the wedding. She gets furious, gets drunk, and ends up with Jesse instead. She is under the impression she has hired him for the night but Jesse has been in love with her for years.

tropes: secret identity;family drama
synopsis_short:
A shooting at a Halloween party, and a daughter gone.
Eve Wilson loses her daughter Amelia in the panic after a shooter turns a Halloween party into chaos. Thirteen years on, the real Amelia has been kidnapped and switched and is waiting tables for the woman pretending to be her mother. What changes it is a ballet competition, and where that puts her is back within reach of her biological family.

primary_title: Find Your Way Back to Me, My Childhood Sweetheart
tropes: childhood sweethearts;secret identity
synopsis_short:
He is looking everywhere for a woman already in the room.
The richest man in the world has everything except the girl he grew up with, and he means to find her and marry her. He is looking in every direction but the right one, because she has been standing next to him the whole time.

She married a man she never once laid eyes on.
Kate married a stranger to secure her inheritance and never saw his face. Two years later she comes back to get the divorce done and be finished with it. Her boss is Jack Townsend, a billionaire she has quietly been crushing on, and his is the name on her marriage certificate.

primary_title: Why My Contract Ex-husband Keeps Chasing Me
tropes: contract marriage;second chance

primary_title: Step Aside, I'm the King of Capital
tropes: secret identity;billionaire

She dumps him for a man who is standing right there.
Cassius spends six years abroad building the world's biggest financial empire under the name Mr S. He comes home to propose to Isabella, and she drops him for someone richer, insisting only the mysterious Mr S would ever be good enough for her. Then a favour lands Cassius in a sudden marriage to Freya, who runs Mirror Media. At Isabella's inauguration party she tries to have him thrown out, over and over, never once guessing who she is talking to.

tropes: summer romance;situationship
synopsis_short:
Fake dating the one person she cannot stand.
Jules needs her mother's medical debt cleared, and faking a relationship with Noah is what pays for it. The problem is that they genuinely hate each other. Then they join forces to get revenge on the friends who have been backstabbing them both, and somewhere in the middle of that the pretending stops being pretend.

tropes: werewolf;forbidden romance
synopsis_short:
She is living in her car and nobody at school knows.
Ivy's family goes bankrupt and she ends up sleeping in her car, keeping it secret from the bullies at her elite private school. Then she finds out she is the mate of two boys at once: Sebastian, heir to a werewolf line, and Zane, a vampire prince. They could not be less alike and both of them are hers.

tropes: forbidden romance;sports romance
synopsis_short:
Her dad coaches the team. Now the star player lives in her house.
Lindsay is determined to find a boyfriend before she graduates, and her attempts keep ending in awkward situations with boys who let her down. Wayne Adams is the star player her father recruited to the school, and he has moved into her home. Her father has warned her off him, so whatever she feels has to stay buried. He is also the one who shows up whenever she is in trouble. What starts between them has to stay quiet, and meanwhile the bullying at school is getting worse and Lindsay is not staying out of it.

Desperate for a way to stay, she flash marries Alex, the street thug she accidentally saved with a single kiss while he was making an escape. When a billionaire takes an interest, the Pattersons very nearly succeed in putting her sister Daphne in her place instead. What none of them account for is Andrew Hills falling for Valerie herself.

They keep the relationship quiet, which gets harder with a morality clause hanging over them and threatening messages arriving about Jayne's late mother.

primary_title: Swapped My Ex for His Billionaire Uncle
tropes: billionaire;second chance;forbidden romance
synopsis_short:
She is finished with love and finished with that family.
Nina once believed the best day of her life would be the one she walked down the aisle towards Evan, her college sweetheart. Then he betrayed her, they divorced, and she decided she was never doing any of it again. Damon is Evan's youngest uncle, and he keeps appearing out of nowhere to drive her crazy. Nina wants nothing more to do with that whole family but Damon is not taking the hint.

alt_titles: After Divorce I'm Spoiled by Three Brothers
tropes: contract marriage;secret identity;heiress
synopsis_short:
Three years a contract wife, and then a helicopter lands.
Catherine Rowen spent three years as a contract wife, treated like staff and dropped the moment the divorce papers were signed. She is pregnant, humiliated and being threatened by her husband's mistress when a helicopter comes down and everything turns over. Catherine is the long lost daughter of the Lane family, and Dominic, Connor and Liam are her brothers.

primary_title: Rented a Billionaire Husband for Christmas

Her way out of the marriage is a baby he will not give her.
Elara's marriage is loveless and the only route out of it runs through having a child, which her husband will not come near her long enough to allow. One night she ends up with Cole instead. She has no idea that Cole is a billionaire keeping it quiet, or that he is her husband's uncle.

tropes: secret identity;revenge;counterattack

The maintenance guy holds a deadly world record nobody knows about.
Carl Oliver was the sharpshooter they called the King of Guns, and he broke the world record for the longest confirmed kill before disappearing completely. These days he does maintenance at a shooting range, where he is regularly looked down on. Then the range comes under threat, and protecting its owner Jane and her daughter Rebecca matters more than staying hidden.

primary_title: The Cooking Queen: A Recipe for Divorce

She was the Queen of Cuisine before she gave it up for him.
Tiffany was known as the Queen of Cuisine and she walked away from all of it to support her husband Barry. Barry repays her by taking his mistress Sera's side and treating Tiffany as though she is worth nothing. She ends up drifting until she finds Claude's small restaurant, where the talent she buried comes straight back and the critics take notice. Then Barry turns up again.

primary_title: We Are Never Ever Getting Back Together

The contract ended without a word. Then he turned up as her boss.
Lisa's contract marriage to Aidan ends without warning and without explanation. What stayed with her is that she always valued him more than he ever valued her. When they cross paths again she takes her moment and leaves him a note he will not enjoy reading but then she starts at her new job, and now Aidan is the man she is reporting to.

tropes: contract marriage;CEO

He needed a wife. She needed money.
Jasper Tate needs a wife and has no time to go looking for one. Chloe Adams needs money and has run out of other ideas. They both go to the same person for help, and Madam G puts them in front of each other. What they sign is a contract and nothing else but it does not stay that way for long.

primary_title: Money, Guns, and a Merry Christmas
tropes: secret identity;contract marriage;rags to riches
synopsis_short:
Everyone at that table has him completely wrong.
Damian runs the most powerful military industrial group in the world, and everyone has him pegged as a salesman scraping three thousand a month. He and Iris enter a quick contract marriage, then he goes home with her for Christmas dinner. Her relatives belittle him all evening and a rival suitor joins in. Damian turns it round on every one of them.

primary_title: The Heiress and Her Possessive Bodyguard

Her groom is in a coma on the wedding day.
Ciara agrees to marry Adrian Lewis while he is lying unconscious, because her family are sick and the money is the only thing that saves them. She is humiliated by the choice and carries that for as long as it lasts. Then Adrian opens his eyes.

primary_title: Uncle William, Please Say I Do!
tropes: contract marriage;age gap;forbidden romance
synopsis_short:
She saves his life. Months later she is engaged to his nephew.
Alaina pulls William out of a car accident that nearly kills him, and he makes her a promise in return. Months later he sees her again at his nephew Jason's engagement party, and the woman Jason is marrying is her. William keeps what he feels to himself and gives her a family heirloom instead. Then Jason betrays her and she calls the engagement off. Her grandmother's Alzheimer's is worsening and there is a wedding the old woman still wants to see, so Alaina asks William for a secret marriage lasting one year.

tropes: billionaire;one night stand
synopsis_short:
Her father needs surgery and she has nothing left to sell.
Violet cannot pay for her father's operation and decides to sell her virginity to cover it. The doctor who answers determinedly tries to change her very dangerous decision. They end up spending the night together anyway, and afterwards Dax cannot get her out of his head even while he is sure she is just another gold digger. And still neither of them has told the truth about themselves yet. Wait until they find out.

tropes: forbidden romance;age gap;college romance
synopsis_short:
He is the last person she should want.
Sylvia Parker is fighting her way through a cutthroat campus and a family that gives her nothing. The one person who steadies her is Lawrence Calhoun, who is cold, strict and the last man she should want. He is also her professor. Whatever is growing between them would destroy both of them if anyone found out.

tropes: revenge;secret identity

tropes: forbidden romance;age gap

tropes: one night stand;holiday romance
synopsis_short: The night before her unwanted wedding, Holly's last night of freedom collides with Nick, a santa stripper who is also her groom's best man.

tropes: sports romance;pregnancy
synopsis_short: Hockey player Logan and Alexis fall for each other before discovering he accidentally killed her brother on the ice a year earlier.

primary_title: Move Aside! I'm the Final Boss
tropes: secret identity;rags to riches;revenge
synopsis_short:
The nobody they threw away owns everything.
Kingsley comes back from the battlefield to a childhood sweetheart who wants nothing more to do with him. She dumps him without ceremony, convinced he is a joke. What she does not know, and what nobody around them knows, is that Kingsley is the secret King of King's Corps and there is no richer man on Earth.

tropes: revenge;secret identity
synopsis_short:
Firing him was the most expensive decision in the building.
Erik is the biggest name in tech in the whole of Silicon Valley, right up until his boss's son sacks him. William makes that call. What Erik does next is walk straight across to the competition, where Evelyn runs the company that has spent years trying to beat his old one.

primary_title: Cooking My Way Back to Love
tropes: second chance;revenge;counterattack
synopsis_short:
The King of Cooking lost everything except the dog.
Leon Kennedy was the finest chef in the country until his wife died in a car accident and the grief took the rest of it. He ends up homeless with nothing left but Dante, his dog. A restaurant owner gives him a job without knowing who he is, and the sous chef Bryant belittles him daily for it. When a businessman called William starts threatening the restaurant, Leon cooks the way he used to. It does not last, because Bryant defames him and William kills his dog. Now Chef Leon is ready to serve his revenge.

tropes: heiress;secret identity;revenge

tropes: bodyguard;contract marriage;revenge

tropes: secret identity;rags to riches

tropes: secret identity;billionaire;fake dating

tropes: secret identity;fake dating;mistaken identity

primary_title: The Lady Boss's Small Town Valentine

primary_title: Pregnant by My Tough Daddy CEO

synopsis_short:
Her brother takes the money meant for her mother's treatment.
The money set aside for her mother's medical care goes to her brother instead, and once she is broke people treat her accordingly. One man steps in while she is being bullied for it. She takes a part time job at a bar and runs into him a second time, and this time he offers to help with the medical bills himself. Before she knows it she's pregnant with twins and living in his house, where she is rather more welcome than she was expecting.

primary_title: Falling for My Ex's Mafia Dad
tropes: mafia;age gap;forbidden romance;pregnancy;billionaire
synopsis_short:
She caught him cheating. What came next was a wedding.
Fay Alden catches her boyfriend Daniel cheating and ends it on the spot. Not long after, she meets Daniel's father, Kent Lippert, who happens to be the Mafia King. A fake marriage pulls her properly into the mob world, and what began as an arrangement turns into something she has to keep hidden from everyone. Then the betrayals start, and not one of them comes from where she is watching.

tropes: one night stand;secret baby;amnesia

primary_title: Claimed by the Alpha I Hate
tropes: werewolf;rejected mate;fated mates;enemies to lovers
synopsis_short:
She blames him for her mother's death.
Daisy Storm has never known what is wrong with her. She cannot shift and she has no wolf, and on her eighteenth birthday her pack and her own mate reject her for it. The one person she finds herself pulled towards is Nolan Fenrir, the Alpha she holds responsible for her mother's death. Neither of them can explain the pull, and neither of them wants it.

tropes: enemies to lovers;secret identity;college romance
synopsis_short:
He gets her fired, then puts her on his payroll.
Emma is class president at a wealthy private school, and nobody there knows she is the poorest girl in it. Her rival, rich bad boy Lucas Bennett, has her fired from her job and then hires her as his personal maid, on the condition that nobody finds out and she caters to his every need.

primary_title: If Loving You is a Sin, then I'll Go to Hell
tropes: forbidden romance;bad boy;pregnancy
synopsis_short:
Her father is a pastor. His family run a gang.
Ellie Jones is a good girl who falls for Asher King, and ends up pregnant. Her pastor father and Asher's family, the Red Snakes, both want the pair of them apart and the baby taken. Asher swears he will protect her whatever it costs him.

tropes: second chance;rockstar
synopsis_short: Based on the novel by Ashley Jade. Rocker bad boy Phoenix broke Lennon's heart and stole her song. Four years later she is hired to keep the spiraling rockstar sober for eight weeks on tour, testing a second chance at love.

primary_title: 30 Days Till I Marry My Husband's Nemesis
tropes: second chance;revenge;enemies to lovers;billionaire
synopsis_short:
She knows exactly which man kills her, because it has already happened.
Blair is murdered by her husband Jack, and then handed a second chance and sent back to do it all differently. Avoiding Jack means marrying someone else before he can reach her, so she picks Nathan, who is Jack's nemesis and her own enemy besides. Whether that is enough to keep her alive is the whole question.

tropes: secret identity;divorce;second chance
synopsis_short: After hooking up with a husband she has never met, Aria learns Benjamin wants a divorce. Hiding her identity, she designs his new house and both fall for each other.

primary_title: Married a Gardener, Got a Prince
tropes: secret identity;flash marriage;billionaire;love after marriage;revenge
synopsis_short: Prince Philip of Lavinia poses as a royal gardener in the US and flash-marries Anna, helping her defeat her stepmother and inherit her mother's company before revealing his identity.

tropes: flash marriage;billionaire
synopsis_short: Left at the altar, Liana impulsively marries mysterious billionaire Jacob; a cold agreement becomes passion amid meddling exes, family drama and corporate battles.

tropes: divorce;family drama
synopsis_short: Diagnosed with cancer and given three months, Caroline is repeatedly wronged by husband Eric after his old flame appears with a child. She divorces him; he only learns of her diagnosis after it is too late for reconciliation.

primary_title: The Billionaire Firefighter and His Sweet Wife
tropes: flash marriage;billionaire;secret identity;CEO
synopsis_short: Abandoned by her fiance during a wedding-day fire, Chloe is rescued by Leo and impulsively marries him to reclaim her mother's inheritance, unaware he is a billionaire CEO who grows utterly devoted to her.

primary_title: Falling for My Dad's Best Friend
tropes: age gap;forbidden romance
synopsis_short: Bold young Kylie tempts her dad's best friend Jaxon; as he struggles to resist, escalating tension leads to an ultimate betrayal that changes everything.

primary_title: My Loser Daddy is a Big Shot
tropes: secret identity;flash marriage;family drama
synopsis_short: Veteran Ethan and CEO Leanne marry on a whim thanks to daughter Cassie. Scorned as a deserter and gold digger, Ethan is secretly leader of the justice group GUARDIAN FORCE, rooting out traitors while being a devoted husband and father.

tropes: secret identity;heiress;CEO;enemies to lovers
synopsis_short: Harvard MBA Audrey Lorenzo Bloom is set to become BloomCo's first female and non-white CEO after years undercover as a cleaning lady. On the eve of her introduction she uncovers her fiance's deportation fraud plot, an executive coup for her white cousin, and that childhood enemy Ryder Marlow may not be an enemy at all.

primary_title: Help! My Hot Boss Has My Nudes!
tropes: boss romance;workplace
synopsis_short: An employee accidentally sends a revealing photo to her hot boss; desire, scandal and secrets turn the office and her heart upside down.

tropes: small town;dark romance
synopsis_short: Ava is on the run from her abusive ex when a cowboy saves her and teaches her how a woman should be loved; she must learn to love again before her ex catches her.

tropes: age gap;one night stand;pregnancy
synopsis_short: After catching her boyfriend cheating with her best friend, Lucia falls into the arms of her ex's dad; one encounter leaves her pregnant.

tropes: forbidden romance;workplace
synopsis_short: Wedding planner Mia needs her business to succeed to pay for her sister's treatment, but falls for the groom, presidential candidate Eli Thorne.

tropes: werewolf;rejected mate;secret baby;second chance
synopsis_short: Lila's fated mate, the rival alpha, rejected her. Now he is back wanting a second chance, but she is hiding their son.

primary_title: Captured and Bound By My CEO
tropes: CEO;family drama;dark romance
synopsis_short: Heir apparent Lydia faces her brother and boyfriend allying with enemy Declan to bring her down, but Declan has been in love with her all along.

primary_title: Tricked into Having my Ex-Husband's Baby
tropes: second chance;pregnancy;divorce
synopsis_short: Facing infertility, Erica hires an escort to get pregnant; her ex-husband Damon secretly takes his place, and now pregnant Erica must decide whether to give him another chance.

tropes: one night stand;pregnancy;college romance;bad boy
synopsis_short: After a one-night stand with campus heartthrob Ben, Kelsey is pregnant and keeps the baby; will flirty fratboy Ben stick around?

tropes: second chance;contract lovers;sports romance;college romance
synopsis_short: Doctor Bella is reunited with first love Adam, now an NHL superstar, when he seeks her help; a contract relationship gives their unfinished love a second chance.

tropes: second chance;forbidden romance
synopsis_short: Gloria fakes being superficial to free her boyfriend, then seven years later is forced into an arranged marriage and finds her fiance's uncle is her now-successful ex.

tropes: fake relationship;CEO;billionaire
synopsis_short: After a cheating boyfriend, a toxic job and a terminal leukemia diagnosis, Tessa starts her bucket list; CEO Cassian Vaughn funds her last wishes if she poses as his fiancee.

tropes: second chance;family drama
synopsis_short: Torn apart five years ago by tragedy, lies and a miscarriage, journalist Sofia and baseball superstar Justin reunite in Los Angeles, uncover the truth and rebuild love from the ruins.

primary_title: Secret Surrogate to the Mafia King
tropes: mafia;pregnancy;dark romance
synopsis_short:
She goes in to sell her eggs and leaves pregnant.
Vanessa Peters sells her eggs to clear her boyfriend's debt, and a mistake at the clinic leaves her carrying a child instead. She finds out he has been cheating on her, decides to keep the baby anyway, and only then learns whose it is. Marcello Lavigne is a ruthless and murderous mafia king, and his answer is to move her into his mansion where he can keep her safe.

tropes: billionaire;secret identity;family drama;rags to riches
synopsis_short: Penniless orphan Jack Parker, scorned by his wife's family, becomes heir to one of the world's richest companies and must prove it before they destroy his marriage and take his child.

primary_title: Countdown to Life: Rescue at 30000 Feet
tropes: secret identity;family drama;suspense
synopsis_short: Elite surgeon Shaun races a donor kidney by plane for dying billionaire Derek Wolf, facing humiliation from the fiancee of Wolf's grandson until she smashes the case and sees whose name is on it.

tropes: secret baby;second chance;billionaire
synopsis_short: With her father imprisoned and facing cancer and a secret pregnancy, heiress Jane stages a fake affair to free her fiance Vincent; years later the billionaire learns he has a 7-year-old son.

primary_title: True Heiress vs. Fake Queen Bee
tropes: heiress;secret identity;mistaken identity
synopsis_short:
One of them is lying about who she is.
Hailey is a wealthy teenager who keeps that very quiet at her new public school. Meanwhile the maid's daughter Candice is passing herself off as the Kaplan heiress and climbing straight to the top, while Hailey takes the bullying at the bottom.

tropes: contract marriage;billionaire;pregnancy
synopsis_short:
No sex, no love, and a baby by contract.
Amelia's sister Abby is dying, and signing a contract marriage is the only way Amelia can pay for what she needs. The terms are exact: no sex, no love, and a baby by insemination. Nathan set it up because he is fighting to get his position as CEO back and his father's wish is the price of it. Neither of them writes feelings into the agreement.

primary_title: OMG, I Got Married in Vegas!
tropes: flash marriage;mistaken identity
synopsis_short: Runaway bride Emily and runaway groom William, unaware of who the other is, flee their own engagement and end up married to each other in Vegas.

primary_title: Resisting Mr. Lloyd: An Age Gap Romance
tropes: age gap;fake relationship;secret identity;CEO
synopsis_short:
Her family want her out of college and married off.
Clarisse is under pressure at home to drop her degree and find a husband. Then she helps an older woman who has been scammed, and she meets the woman's grandson Austin. He runs the Lloyd Group, and what he offers is money for a fake marriage that gives his grandmother the wedding she keeps asking for. Clarisse takes the arrangement but Austin never tells her who he actually is.

primary_title: Mommy Don't Cry, Daddy is Sorry
tropes: revenge;secret identity;family drama
synopsis_short:
The wife he buried is very much alive.
Wayne loses his wife Sienna in a mental hospital, then is tricked into bringing home the wrong daughter. But Sienna is alive and now she's back with a new identity, and a list of sins those who wronged her need to pay for.

primary_title: My Firefighter Fiance Returns as a Billionaire
tropes: amnesia;independent woman;revenge;second chance
synopsis_short: Presumed dead in a firefighting mission, Archer reappears at Alice's forced second wedding, now engaged to someone else.

tropes: family drama;divorce
synopsis_short: Charlotte's daughter dies through her husband's negligence and favoritism; he refuses to believe her and makes her life hell believing she is hiding their daughter.

tropes: flash marriage;boss romance;small town
synopsis_short: After a flash marriage, country girl Daisy is married to her new boss Hamilton Smith of Smith Media, with an evil VP scheming to destroy them before they confess their love.

tropes: divorce;second chance;family drama;counterattack
synopsis_short: House husband Daniel, invisible beside his megastar wife, decides to divorce America's Sweetheart when an old flame returns to seduce her; she may realize too late what she lost.

tropes: amnesia;second chance
synopsis_short: Seven years after losing her, Raphael Stone finds his wife Lucy alive but unable to move, speak, or remember him.

tropes: family drama;billionaire
synopsis_short: Abandoned at five, lucky Lila is adopted by kind billionaire Jonathan, helps his silent son find his voice, and exposes the schemers who abandoned her.

primary_title: Do Not Disturb: Lady Boss in Disguise!
tropes: secret identity;heiress;workplace;billionaire
synopsis_short:
Nobody at the hotel knows whose daughter she is.
Violet Trenton is set on becoming the heiress to her family's hotel chain. So she goes undercover in her own hotels as a cleaning lady, where not one person knows her face, and deals with all the people causing trouble one at a time.

tropes: flash marriage;billionaire
synopsis_short:
Stood up by her fiance, married by the end of the night.
Claire Duval is happily engaged to Dylan Maxwell right up until she learns he has been seeing her friend Ava. Stranded that evening with nothing much left to lose, she quietly marries Christian Cross instead. An unexpected marriage they both take a chance on.

tropes: second chance;boss romance;revenge
synopsis_short: Lucie broke up with Felix to protect him from her debtors; years later he is wealthy, she is his employee, and he vows to make her feel his pain until he learns her true intentions.

primary_title: My Dear Brother is Obsessed With Me
tropes: fake relationship;forbidden romance
synopsis_short: Clyde hires actress Violet to play his long-lost sister for his father's dying wish; living together they develop a forbidden romance an antagonist tries to destroy.

primary_title: Runaway Single Mom, Safe in His Arms
tropes: billionaire;family drama
synopsis_short:
She gets herself and her daughter out.
Maria leaves an abusive situation with her daughter Judy and starts again from nothing. With enemies around every corner from her workplace to her daughter's elite schools. She stands against everyone including her own family who let her down. Then Levi comes into her life and everything changes.

tropes: sports romance;pregnancy;second chance
synopsis_short:
The scholarship arrives at the worst possible moment.
Caroline Mills and Easton Black are together and happy. Then the hockey scholarship Easton has worked his whole life for finally comes through, and his mother decides a pregnant girlfriend has no place in that plan. She tells Caroline to get rid of the baby, and everything the two of them had starts coming apart.

primary_title: OMG, I'm Surrounded by Three Princes
tropes: heiress;secret identity;forbidden romance
synopsis_short: Betrayed street vendor Erin is secretly the long-lost princess, but her best friend claims her identity; Prince Charles repeatedly protects her and feelings grow for her supposed brother.

tropes: contract marriage;secret identity;CEO
synopsis_short: Nurse Aria contract-marries billionaire Mason sight unseen for her mother's operation; three years later neither recognizes the other as they fall in love.

primary_title: Found A Homeless Billionaire Husband for Christmas
tropes: billionaire;secret identity;flash marriage;holiday romance;revenge
synopsis_short:
She married him when he had nothing.
Victoria is heading home to Texas with her fiance Carl to plan their wedding when he humiliates and betrays her. To save face in front of her family she asks Simon to marry her instead, a homeless man she has been quietly helping. She has no idea who he really is. Simon runs the Savage Group, the biggest company in the country.

primary_title: Open Your Eyes, My Billionaire Husband
tropes: contract marriage;billionaire
synopsis_short:
Her mother's care comes at the price of a husband who cannot object.
Hailey has no way to cover her mother's medical bills, and her family will only step in on one condition. She has to marry Samuel Trent, a billionaire who has been unconscious since a car accident nearly killed him. She takes the deal, because there is no other way to pay for her mother's care. Then Samuel wakes up and finds out he is engaged to a woman he has never met.

primary_title: Wings of Fire: The Dragon Slayer Is My Ex-Lover
tropes: secret baby;second chance
synopsis_short: Freya left first love Tristan five years ago without telling him she had his child; now he returns as a dragon-slaying hero and she is his personal servant.

tropes: sports romance;college romance;second chance
synopsis_short: After her quarterback fiance's betrayal, cheerleader Maddie is drawn to oddly familiar player Cameron while her ex, the cheer captain, and his mother plot against them.

tropes: vampire;secret baby;second chance
synopsis_short: Eight years after Vincent abandoned her, single mom Ella is saved from a rooftop fall by a masked flying man; Vincent denies it but demands she move in for protection, and he may not be entirely human.

primary_title: Two Alphas Are in Love with Me
tropes: werewolf;one night stand;pregnancy;fake relationship
synopsis_short: Wolfless Lyra, abused captive of Alpha Roland for seven years, becomes pregnant by Moonshadow Alpha Alfred after a one-night stand; he rescues her and they form a Fake Luna contract.

tropes: flash marriage;CEO;family drama;billionaire
synopsis_short:
A husband, two stepkids, and a flash marriage.
Cassandra flash marries a man who adores her, and two stepchildren who are adorable come as a package deal. It is a better deal than she was expecting to get. But there is something about those children she cannot quite place. She better figure it out fast though as her past is about to catch up to her.

tropes: contract marriage;heiress;billionaire
synopsis_short:
She needs a husband by the end of the week.
Betrayed by her fiance and her own stepsister, Victoria cannot claim her inheritance without a husband. So she contract marries Teddy, the man who once got her out of trouble. Neither of them expects the arrangement to turn into anything real. It does anyway.

tropes: werewolf;secret identity;revenge;family drama
synopsis_short:
She sent her daughter somewhere safe. It was not safe.
Jessica is the Wolf Queen and she has had enough of war, so she hides herself in the woods as an ordinary healer. She sends her daughter to the Russo pack believing it will give the girl a normal, happy life. The Russo pack treat her daughter as a slave, humiliate her and beat her, purely because she arrives with no name and no power behind her. When Jessica understands what she has done, she goes to get her daughter back and to make every one of them pay.

tropes: cinderella;billionaire
synopsis_short:
Her own father turned her into the help.
Cindy has never been treated as a daughter in her father's house, where the circumstances of her birth are held against her. She is demoted to maid, then lined up as a substitute bride for a marriage that was never meant to be hers. Then billionaire Charles Kane falls for her, and love turns up from a direction she had stopped expecting it from.

tropes: secret identity
synopsis_short: City hero Lyndon hid his identity to protect girlfriend Tatiana; when the Sewer Rat returns to attack City Hall and Tatiana's betrayal is revealed, Lyndon becomes a hero again.

tropes: sports romance;college romance;childhood sweethearts
synopsis_short:
She asks out her best friend and the whole school watches it go wrong.
Skylar Heron has spent her life being invisible, and senior year opens with her asking Jamie Donner out in front of everybody and being humiliated for it. Jamie has been her best friend and the boy next door since they were children. They get paired for a class project, and then his house burns down and he moves into her room. His ex girlfriend makes life difficult for both of them, so they set about turning Skylar into the most popular girl in school.

primary_title: I'm In Love With My Brother's Best Friend?!
tropes: brothers best friend;college romance;childhood sweethearts
synopsis_short:
She moves in with her boyfriend and catches him cheating the same day.
Kaitlyn Sinclair starts her freshman year sharing an off campus apartment with her high school sweetheart, and catches him cheating almost immediately. With nowhere else to go she moves in with her brother, which means sharing the place with his best friend Cole, who is doing grad school on the same campus. The crush she had on him as a child blooms once again. Between spiteful exes, mean girls and her own brother, there is no shortage of people who would like to put distance between Cole and Kaitlyn. Will they succeed?

primary_title: Breaking the Deal with My Hockey Bad Boy
tropes: fake relationship;stepbrother;sports romance;bad boy
synopsis_short: Jane's secret crush on her stepbrother is known only to hockey bad boy Zach, who fakes a relationship with her to protect her secret and slowly heals her heart.

primary_title: Don't Miss Me When I'm Gone
tropes: family drama;second chance;revenge
synopsis_short:
She left, and every one of them fell apart.
After losing her parents she is taken in by her godmother Sandra, and grows up under the same roof as Sandra's two sons, the Miller brothers. She has always assumed she would end up with one of them. Then the maid's daughter moves in, and the future she counted on quietly disappears. So she does too, and the brothers only work out what they had once there is nobody left to ask.

tropes: college romance;fake relationship
synopsis_short: Naive witch Astrid leaves her all-female coven for a co-ed school seeking masculine energy, striking a deal with blind, handsome Nate: cure his sight and he will do anything she asks.

tropes: amnesia;secret identity;flash marriage;billionaire
synopsis_short:
She wakes from a murder attempt with no memory of who she is.
Eliza Spencer built her own fortune, and she survives an attempt on her life only to wake with no memory of any of it. Justin Patton is the handsome stranger in a wheelchair who rescues her, and she marries him without knowing he is a billionaire too, or that the wheelchair is an act. When her memory comes back she says nothing about who she is, because she wants her company back off her greedy family and Justin needs protecting from his half brother and his step mother.

primary_title: My Sister Is the Warlord Queen
tropes: secret identity;revenge;family drama
synopsis_short:
They think she cleans floors for a living.
Abandoned by their parents, Catherine and Grace Blackwood grew up with nobody but each other. Catherine turns up to Grace's engagement party straight from an undercover job, still dressed as a janitor, and Grace's new in laws treat her accordingly. She lets them. Then Grace is betrayed by her own fiance, and Catherine stops pretending to be anything less than the Warlord Queen.

tropes: childhood sweethearts;friends to lovers
synopsis_short: Childhood best friends Penny and Mason finally fall in love, but after their first night together Penny is diagnosed with cancer and pushes him away to spare him.

tropes: contract marriage;billionaire;secret identity;heiress
synopsis_short:
The inheritance is hers on one condition. She has to be married.
Shelby's father leaves her everything and attaches terms, the main one being a wedding before she can claim any of it. So she marries a stranger with nothing to his name, which is the cheapest way of satisfying the paperwork. But Griffin is not poor. He is a billionaire, and he has had Shelby in mind since the last time the two of them met three years ago.

primary_title: I Swapped Bodies with My Nemesis
tropes: body swap;enemies to lovers
synopsis_short: Forced into an arranged marriage they both despise, Nick and Lexey have their souls switched by Cupid and must live in each other's bodies.

tropes: bad boy;sports romance;dark romance
synopsis_short: With her family broke and her sweetheart turned violent, Olivia is rescued by rising boxer Bash McDaniels, who must choose between his dreams and saving her as danger closes in.

tropes: werewolf;fated mates;enemies to lovers
synopsis_short: Alpha princess Maeve enters the kingdom's brutal war college and finds a fated bond with Saxon Blackmoor, the most powerful wolf there and her sworn enemy.

tropes: friends to lovers;second chance
synopsis_short: Dying senior Isabel plans to confess to best friend Alex, but a misunderstanding ruins their friendship; ten years later Alex finds her vlogs and learns a truth that changes his world.

tropes: contract marriage;secret identity;billionaire
synopsis_short: Forced to take her sister's place and marry Tommy Anderson to save the family business, Emma finds him handsome and wealthy and falls for him despite the contract.

primary_title: Mommy, I Got You A Date
tropes: secret baby;second chance;family drama
synopsis_short: Annie left imprisoned Liam under pressure from the wealthy Holland family, hiding her pregnancy; six years later heir Liam wins her back through their son Henry.

primary_title: The Gourmet CEO Turns out to Be My Baby's Dad
tropes: one night stand;secret baby;CEO
synopsis_short: Betrayed by family, Skylar has an unexpected one-night stand with Klein Group CEO Maxwell and returns six years later with his son, opening a restaurant fate steers him into.

primary_title: The Heiress Is Back, Three Brothers on Their Knees
tropes: heiress;family drama;revenge
synopsis_short: Genius heiress Blair returns home to find her mother beaten and branded a homewrecker by her three brothers, with the maid installed as the new Mrs. Beaumont; she fights to expose the betrayal.

tropes: secret identity;rags to riches;revenge
synopsis_short:
His fiancee poisoned him and put him over the side of the boat.
Ryan Chase is a Wall Street tycoon until Mia poisons him at a yacht party and pushes him overboard. He survives, but he comes out of the water with no voice, no identity and nothing to his name. Sophia is the mute woman who finds him, takes him back to her family's small restaurant and gives him a job, and her stepmother Diane makes him pay for every day of it. He and Sophia fall in love. Meanwhile Mia is forging a marriage certificate to take his empire, and when Sophia's father James falls critically ill, Ryan finally reaches out to the one man still loyal to him.

primary_title: She's Not Homeless, She's Healer Goddess!
tropes: secret identity;cinderella
synopsis_short:
They see the clothes and decide they know exactly what she is.
Trixie dresses like she has nothing, so everyone around her decides she is a gold digger and says so. What not one of them has worked out is that she is the only person alive who can cure Lysander Armstrong, a war hero and the richest man in the nation.

tropes: secret identity;independent woman
synopsis_short: Lion, once the Grand Slam champion of golf, disappears after losing his wife to care for his family, until the game calls him back.

tropes: age gap;billionaire;CEO;flash marriage;one night stand
synopsis_short: Based on the novel by L. Steele. After her fiance cheats, Vivian flash-marries a hot silver fox, only to realize he is her ex's dad. The deal: two weeks of marriage.

tropes: dark romance;enemies to lovers
synopsis_short: Scarlett Jameson, imprisoned for a crime she didn't commit, lands on the radar of prison guard Jack Rayne, whose taunts may hide a darker motive.

tropes: secret identity;revenge
synopsis_short: Assassin Madeline Archer doesn't want bloodshed, but if she stops killing her little sister dies. Forced to take a contract on Hayden Kent, she runs into problems.

primary_title: The Billionaire Married a Homeless Girl
tropes: billionaire;pregnancy
synopsis_short:
Her father put her out for keeping the baby.
Adele Moore gets pregnant after one night with a stranger, and when she says she is keeping the child her father throws her out of the house. She and her son Brad become homeless. She does her best to give her son everything she can. Years later Brad runs into a billionaire called Heston Deleon by pure chance, and Heston works out that the boy is his. He loses their trail before he can reach them but he and Adele are destined to find their way back to each other.

primary_title: I Had a Baby without You
tropes: billionaire;CEO;contract lovers;flash marriage;secret identity;mistaken identity;one night stand;pregnancy
synopsis_short:
Five years on, he does not recognise her.
Scarlett saved Brandon's life five years ago, spent one night with him, then vanished without a word. She is back now, and she looks nothing like the woman he remembers. In the years between, Brandon has become a reclusive CEO who lets almost nobody near him. What he does not know is that Scarlett has a daughter, and that the girl is his.

tropes: amnesia;CEO;mistaken identity;second chance;billionaire
synopsis_short: Framed and stripped of her freedom, her child, and her love, Nicole returns seven years later as a nanny in the very house that destroyed her.

tropes: fake relationship;friends to lovers
synopsis_short:
He broke her heart four years ago. Now he needs a favour.
Reese has not seen Grayson since he broke her heart four years ago, and he was her best friend as well as her first love. When the two of them end up in the same room again, he asks her to pose as his girlfriend for his sister's wedding. She says yes.

primary_title: Cancel the Wedding, Queen Moves On
tropes: billionaire;independent woman
synopsis_short:
The wedding is off. Everything after that is hers.
Maria's life is perfect right up to the moment she finds out her fiance has been having an affair. She calls the wedding off and takes back control of everything she gave him. Then Alec walks back into her life, the ex she lost years ago.

primary_title: In Love with a Single Farmer-Daddy
tropes: billionaire;flash marriage;secret identity
synopsis_short:
Her family married her off and washed their hands of her.
Natalie is married off to Rhett, a rural farmer raising a daughter who does not speak. When she first arrives she is shunned. Will she be able to turn things around? Ellie has been badly let down by the people around her, and the bond those two build becomes the thing Natalie will protect at any cost.

tropes: CEO;divorce
synopsis_short:
Ten years of a marriage nobody knew about.
Beatrice Lawson eloped with Desmond Belmont in college and has been quietly married to him ever since. Then she finds out about the wealthy socialite he has been seeing, and she files for divorce. What she wants after that is her own life back rather than any more time spent living in his shadow, so she gets a new apartment and a career. Then Damian Crowley walks into her brand new life.

tropes: billionaire;contract lovers
synopsis_short: Sofia, desperate to pay her mother's medical bills, agrees to marry comatose billionaire Samuel.

primary_title: How to Tame a Silver Fox
tropes: age gap;billionaire;enemies to lovers;independent woman
synopsis_short:
The plan was to get rid of him.
Harper Reeves is a Yale senior with an overprotective man sized problem: her dad's best friend and business partner Chris Collins. So she launches Operation Seduction to drive him out. Nothing goes to plan.

tropes: billionaire;CEO;contract lovers;fake relationship;flash marriage
synopsis_short:
The eight year old did the matchmaking.
Every is an orphan with nothing to her name, and the contract marriage she signs is with the billionaire Julian Barlow. The person who set the whole meeting up in the first place is Bella Barlow, Julian's daughter, who is eight. What was only ever meant to be an arrangement on paper does not stay that way.

tropes: billionaire;contract lovers;independent woman;pregnancy
synopsis_short:
One rule in the contract. No falling in love.
Katie's younger sister is getting worse, and the way Katie pays for the treatment is by signing a contract to carry a billionaire's heir. Convincing his grandfather that they are a real couple proves harder than either of them expected, and all that pretending puts her and Mr Brandt in each other's company constantly. The contract has exactly one rule in it… no falling in love.

tropes: age gap;billionaire;CEO;flash marriage;pregnancy
synopsis_short:
On her twenty second birthday she wishes for someone to love her.
Lyla has grown up feeling she does not measure up, made to work for her family and treated badly wherever she turns. She saves a man called Leo while working a part time job, and he is gentle with her in a way she is not used to at all. She becomes pregnant, he takes her in and looks after her, and what grows between them is real. Then they start pulling at the question of where Lyla actually came from.

tropes: age gap;billionaire
synopsis_short:
She goes in for a routine exam and leaves pregnant.
Oscar needs an heir quickly to hold on to his position at the company, so he arranges a surrogacy. A mistake at the clinic puts his sperm into Phoebe instead, who is only there for a gynaecological exam. He wants the baby kept, and the way he proposes to guarantee that is a contract marriage. Neither of them is ready for what the arrangement asks of them.

primary_title: Fake Married to My Billionaire CEO
tropes: billionaire;CEO;flash marriage;secret identity
synopsis_short:
Her ex cleaned her out. A stranger married her on sight.
Sam's ex cheats on her and takes her money on the way out. Calladan Vandalay marries her the moment he sees her, and does not mention that he is quietly the richest man in the country. The family and friends circling Sam would very much like to know who he really is, and his is not the only identity being kept quiet.

tropes: fake relationship;friends to lovers
synopsis_short:
She has the voice. Someone else is taking the credit.
Ivy is a high school sophomore with a remarkable voice, and a wealthy heiress who keeps that quiet because she wants friends who like her rather than her money. Vanessa becomes her best friend and then guilt trips her into singing as her voice double. Ivy only sees it for what it is when she catches her boyfriend with Vanessa, and turns to her childhood best friend Blake, the school's star quarterback.

primary_title: My Double Proxy Marriage to a Billionaire
tropes: billionaire;CEO;fake relationship;secret identity
synopsis_short:
She turns up to sign the papers and finds she is already married.
Ella Davenport is the outcast of her family, and her father has arranged for her to marry a man nobody would choose. Marked as a dragon's mate, and not just any dragon.

Yet the Mark is there, and it belongs to the Dragon King himself, the one whose dark beauty and lethal power nobody dares discuss above a whisper. A mark like that could be a death sentence. It could also be the key to a secret big enough to change everything. Which is it?

When you're forced to wed the dark and dangerous Alpha Ronan — your mortal enemy — you're sure you'll kill each other before you make it to the altar. But when a common enemy threatens to destroy your pack, will you accept that you are fated to one another? Or reap deadly consequences?

primary_title: Ex-Convict Nanny and Billionaire Single Dad
tropes: billionaire
synopsis_short:
She walks out of prison and straight into his house.
Fresh out of prison, Grace lands a job as a nanny for Alex Hill, a ruthless billionaire who cares about exactly one thing: his daughter. Grace passes every test he sets her. She is also carrying a secret that could destroy everything good she has found there.

primary_title: The CEO and Her Daughter's Secret Father
synopsis_short: Connor Reed, the world's most powerful arms dealer, saves Charlotte Hayes and spends the night with her while undercover. Four years later, still in hiding, Charlotte shows up... with his son. Now Connor must protect them both... without revealing his true identity.

primary_title: Stand Aside, the Billionaire Is Here
I Married as the Replacement Bride
synopsis_short: Martina is the perfect Mafia daughter. Beautiful, quiet, and — most important of all — obedient. But to protect the one she loves most, she'll go against her father's orders and take her sister's place as bride to the deadliest, most notorious Mafia don of all... the Butcher.

primary_title: Park Avenue Girls Don't Play Nice
synopsis_short:
The scholarship was her way out. They stole it.
Anna Sinclair is cheated out of the Paris art scholarship that was her only escape from her abusive parents. So she reinvents herself as a glamorous New York socialite and sets her sights on rich kid Preston Kingsley for a second shot at her dream. The complication is Brooks Whitmore, Preston's best friend, Upper East Side royalty, and the person most likely to expose everything she's hiding. Falling for him could ruin her. She's falling anyway.
A werewolf cursed to never shift. A vampire with dark secrets. Kaiya and Talon are supposed to be mortal enemies, but what will the two do when the impossible happens and... they form a mate bond?!

The good girl and the bad boy grew up in the same house.
To everyone else, Kane is a dangerous bad boy, the stepbrother to steer clear of. Nicole never managed the steering clear. She is the good girl of the family, and she never stopped loving him. Then comes the night of a deadly street race with Kane at the centre of it, and Nicole runs into the road itself to stop him throwing his life away. He knows he shouldn't want her. He wants her anyway.

After Romeo Costa ruins Dallas Townsend's reputation at the debutante ball and forces her into a marriage, Dallas makes a new plan: seduce him, break his rule, and get the family she’s always dreamed of. But Romeo is not easy to break. And Dallas isn't the type of girl to give up.

tropes: comeback story;revenge
synopsis_short: In a tale of transformation and revenge, bullied high schooler Alexandra reinvents herself as "Lexi" with the help of childhood friend Dan, returning to expose her tormentors, reclaim her dignity, and find true love.

Second chances rarely simmer this well.
Austin Harrington was the love of Grace Mitchell's life, right up until he left her standing at the altar. She spent years believing the worst of him, never knowing his grandfather had forced him into the family business that very day. Now that same business is bringing him back to her on a much grander scale. Second chance romance, aged to perfection.

After realizing she's been hating the wrong man her entire life, Elena dies in the arms of her husband Marcus. In a twist of fate, Elena is brought back in time. It's not too late, she still has time to change everything. In this life, she won't hate her husband... she will protect him at all cost.

This Christmas, Eddie travels to his loving wife’s hometown to finally reveal he’s the billionaire CEO of the nation’s hottest start-up. But in a house and town full of Scrooges, will Eddie’s arrival be a Christmas present, or go down like a lump of coal?

tropes: love after marriage;secret identity

primary_title: My Gorgeous Wife is an Ex-Convict
synopsis_short:
Three years in prison for a murder she did not commit.
Brielle's own fiance believed she killed his sister, and his word helped send her to rot in prison. Three years later she's free, and she wants her innocence proven and her name back. A mysterious, handsome stranger called Jay appears to lend a hand, but there's far more to Jay than he's letting on. Whose side is he really on?

primary_title: My Husband Killed Me, then I Won the Mega Ball!
synopsis_short:
Her husband murdered her. Then she woke up.
Adoria Cummins is murdered by her own husband, and wakes up back in time with every memory of how it happens. Armed with her knowledge of the future, she sets about repaying everyone who wronged her, starting with a winning Mega Ball ticket. Then Elijah Snyder walks in, a lawyer who seems firmly on her side. There is just something about him that feels far too familiar. Where does she know him from?

tropes: billionaire
synopsis_short:
Her biggest mistake became her best decision.
Taylor Young gave up her Nashville music dream to chase her childhood sweetheart to Oakville University, sure she stood a chance with him. All it earned her was humiliation. Then she meets Lord Travis Harrington, and suddenly the worst decision of her life starts looking like the smartest thing she ever did.

primary_title: Lady Boss Takes on Vegas Bullies!
synopsis_short:
The janitor owns the casino. Nobody believes her.
Jane goes undercover as a janitor in her own casino to investigate reports of staff being abused. But when she finally reveals her identity to protect her loyal workers, nobody believes a word of it, because someone's stolen her name and her seat as the casino's executive. Now the real boss is scrubbing floors while an impostor runs her empire. How does a janitor take back an empire?

tropes: revenge;secret identity

primary_title: Out of My Way! The Reborn Mafia Queen Is Here
synopsis_short:
She remembers exactly who stole her life.
In her first life, Felicia bullied Arya, stole her identity, and drove her to her death. Reborn with every memory intact, Arya is done being the victim. She's the true mafia heiress, and this time she outwits Felicia at every turn, protects the people she loves, and keeps her lethal combat skills hidden until the perfect moment. Everyone will realise who the real heiress is soon enough. Felicia should start running now.

Two playboys, one broken heart, one flight to London.
Maddie Sinclair has always put Ethan Sutton first, and being the it boy of Lowell Private Academy, he let her. Then she catches him cheating with the heiress Vanessa Archibald, and Maddie starts planning her escape to London, helped along by Ethan's own opportunistic mother. Now Ethan's fighting to win her back before she boards that plane, and Rhys Wyndham, the mysterious new bad boy fresh from London, is making a very tempting case for the other side. Who gets her heart before takeoff?

primary_title: The Return of the Lost Striker
The Lost Son Returns as the Duke
synopsis_short: In The Lost Son Returns as the Duke movie: Kidnapped as a child, Arthur, Duke of Mercia, returns to his village to reunite with his long-lost family. What he didn't expect was to find them abused by everyone in town. With his identity a secret, will Arthur be able to avenge them?

By day she is broke. Online she is the one to beat.
The Blackgrove Reign tournament pays fifty thousand dollars, and to Brooklyn, broke and from the trailer park, that prize is a way out. Her alter ego Echo is good enough to take it too, if she can dethrone the reigning champion, Thorne. Here's the joke: offline, Thorne is Ethan, her TA, her best friend's older brother, and the cocky frat king she keeps butting heads with. He discovers her secret first and logs in to toy with her, then falls for her skill and fire instead. In the game they're unstoppable partners. Out of it, bitter rivals. How long before the two worlds collide?

He came home from war. His sister was already dead.
War hero Harrison returns to find his sister dead at the hands of her own fiance, Karter. Still in his worn fatigues, Harrison walks into Karter's banquet and makes one calm announcement: Karter's punishment arrives in three days. Nobody in that room knows who he really is yet. The countdown has already started.

tropes: billionaire
synopsis_short:
She's going to make him pay.
Ivy Donahue married the man of her dreams and got an endless cycle of misery and heartbreak for her trouble. Then her husband crosses the one line he can never take back, and Ivy stops pretending. She is no ordinary housewife. She is a billionaire heiress, and she is about to make him pay for every single one of her tears.

Vesper, who is determined to raise money to save her father, finds Raymond, the boss of the Hell Gang, to become his contracted lover. However, Vesper doesn't know that Raymond has been secretly in love with her for many years. How can they overcome the misunderstandings between money and love...

tropes: betrayal;billionaire;contract;contract marriage;enemies to lovers;love after marriage;mystery;toxic relationship
synopsis_short:
She marries him to save the family name.
Veronika Aspen is made to marry Mason Powell, a cold and ruthless man, because it is the only way to protect what her family built. The world she marries into runs on secrets and leverage, and staying in it means staying a step ahead of her own husband.

tropes: bullying;dark romance;enemies to lovers;forbidden love;royal;toxic relationship
synopsis_short:
He takes the throne back, and then he takes her.
King Lucien spends years in captivity before he takes his throne back, and the first thing he claims afterwards is his enemy's daughter. Princess Danika is meant to pay for what her father did, and Lucien has every intention of making her. What he does not plan for is the way her kindness works on him.

synopsis_short:
The one night stand was supposed to be the end of it.
Kyla's friends talk her into a one night stand to get over a cheating ex, and she decides that is love and lust dealt with so she can concentrate on her career. Then she starts her job as a marketing assistant and the stranger from that night turns out to be her new boss. Kyla wants to keep it professional but he is not easily put off.

He has everything except the one thing that counts.
Lord Gideon Archer is not just any lord, he is a lycan lord, with a billion dollar fortune and a penthouse to match. By rights he should be the happiest man alive but he is not, because no lycan is content without his mate. He is on the point of giving up on ever finding her when Layla walks in, a twenty two year old werewolf working as a maid to put herself through college.

When Alice’s little brother falls ill, she finds herself in desperate need of money. Gideon Maslow offers her an insane deal: become his wife for a year, provide him an heir, and receive one million dollars. Can such a union have a happily-ever-after, or is it doomed to fail?

When Freya wakes up in an Italian villa next to a gorgeous stranger, she has no idea how she got there. As she examines the mysterious Greek god of a man next to her, she tries to remember… was he an innocent one-night stand?\n\nOr is the truth far darker?

Mason Knight. A billionaire heartthrob with looks that make women stop and stare as he walks by. Jamie had always told herself she’d never be one of “those” women who fell for her boss. But then, she’d never had someone like Mason set his sights on her…

When Hayley, a tough-as-nails bartender, crosses paths with Luca, her club's mafia boss, sparks fly. Their worlds clash in a fiery dance of passion and power. But can she let Luca see past her defenses into her scarred heart? Will their fiery connection set ablaze a deadly storm?

After being unable to protect herself from the unwanted advances of her date, Hannah feels weak and powerless. That's when Jordan swoops in, a personal trainer who will make Hannah sweat... in more ways than one.

Her: the curvy girl, nervously starting her first day at a new school. Him: the brooding football jock, who takes the seat behind her in class. He’s dead-set on making her senior year a living hell. But could his relentless teasing actually be hiding something deeper?

Axel is known for being cold, calculating and ruthless. It’s how he became one of the most feared gangsters of his city. He takes what he wants, when he wants...And what he wants now, more than anything, is Talia. [Adapted from the Galatea story 'Captured by the Mafia King']

Savannah’s life takes a sharp turn after losing her family in a tragic accident. While rebuilding her world, she encounters Damon, the brooding prince of a local biker gang. Drawn together by an undeniable chemistry, Savannah finds herself torn between resisting her feelings and falling for him.
Dragged into a twisted world of mafia men and mayhem, Elaina is forced to endure things no human should have to… but what if she begins to like it?

Fresh out of college, Maddie moves in with her brother’s best friends—identical twins with matching looks and a shared desire for her. As attraction builds, the question remains: is three a crowd... or is it the perfect number?

Georgina Evans has always hated Andrew McGabe, the high school playboy. Avoiding him was easy—until her best friend Jake moved in and, to her dismay, turned out to be friends with Andrew. Now, Andrew's constantly around, and his charm is making it harder to keep hating him.
